svg.aria-label: AlcorLedger: hash-chained ledger with a privacy gate
svg.text: AlcorLedger: hash-chained ledger with a privacy gate

g.font-family: Cascadia Mono, Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
g.text: $ python AlcorLedger/demo/run_demo.py
continuity-core demo: hash-chained ledger with a privacy gate
== 1. Append entries: each one commits to the one before it ==
line 1: decision decision-1 previous=000000000000 hash=4766c134dfa6
line 2: observation obs-1 previous=4766c134dfa6 hash=006b642ce69f
line 3: wishlist wish-1 previous=006b642ce69f hash=804d645ef0d5
proven: the first entry points at the all-zero hash
proven: every other entry stores the hash of the entry before it
== 2. Privacy gate: a secret is refused by default ==
proven: an entry containing an email address is refused
refused: entry contains blocked data categories: email
finding: label=email location=$.statement length=17 fingerprint=ff8d9819fc0e
proven: nothing was written to the ledger
proven: the error and the findings describe the value but never contain it
== 3. Privacy gate: redaction is explicit, and the original never reaches disk ==
stored statement: Page the on-call engineer at <REDACTED:EMAIL> if the export fails.
stored metadata : {"api_key": "<REDACTED:SENSITIVE-KEY:API_KEY>", "region": "eu-west"}
proven: neither original value appears anywhere in the file
proven: only the sensitive key was replaced; harmless metadata is kept
== 4. Verify the chain with the CLI ==
continuity verify ledger.jsonl -> exit 0, entries=5
proven: an untouched ledger verifies
== 5. Tamper with one line on disk ==
proven: line 2 now says 4 seconds instead of 41 seconds
continuity verify ledger.jsonl -> exit 1
error: line 2: entry_hash mismatch
... (19 lines omitted) ...
proven: a secret is refused with exit code 2
continuity list --limit 1 -> cli-1: Tests and receipts outrank narrative confidence.
proven: list streams entries and honours --limit
continuity scan notes.txt -> exit 1, label=email, length=17, fingerprint=e0d47ca1bc1e
proven: scan exits 1 and reports the category, not the value
== 9. Rebuild a recorded three-turn exchange from the chain alone ==
state_digest=3f89f7f09657 passes=3 cache_used=False
proven: three identical cold reconstructions agree, and turn 3 ran in a distinct process
turn 2 recorded cache_used=True -> cache-use-not-proven-false
proven: a recorded cache use fails closed
one line edited on disk -> ledger-chain-invalid
proven: reconstruction refuses a ledger that fails verify
All 22 claims proven.
